balls.text: goes for the big drive but can't beat the cover fielder.
moves away and hits the full delivery to deep cover
Warne is run out It was slashed to deep point region .. Warne turns for the second but his partner is not interested. Warne is unable to beat the throw from Jakati. Three in three for Chennai!
Two in two. Abhishek goes for the slog but skies it high for a comfortable catch for Vijay at long-on
yorker length outside off, Dogra doesn't get bat to ball and they try to steal a bye. Dhoni rushes in and throws the ball to the bowler who takes out the bails
sprays a full toss outside off, the batsman reaches out for the drive and edges it through the vacant slip region
Slice of life. He went down on his knee to slice a full delivery to backward point boundary. The players in the dug-out love it.
slower one outside off, driven to deep cover
low dipping full toss on the off stump line, pushed out to deep cover
backs away to guide the really full delivery to Badri at backward point
goes for the lofted off drive but miscues it completely and Murali runs in to  take a comfortable catch
forced towards sweeper cover
yorker length outside off stump and Abishek can't get bat on ball
moves outside leg and flat-bats the short delivery to cover boundary. He slapped it hard.
slower one, around off, run down to short third-man

Soft dismissal. He was looking to go towards the off-stump, Thushara tucked him up with a delivery on the middle . Ojha tried to lap it over short fine-leg but ended up sending a dolly to the fielder there.  Fine entertaining knock from Ojha.
leans across to push a length delivery well outside off to extra cover
Whack. Full in length and outside off, Voges slaps it to the straight boundary.
And just to show that he is not only an off-side player, he goes over long-on this time. The bottom-hand kicked in big time into the shot and he scooped the full delivery over the boundary line
on the off stump line, cut away to sweeper cover
loopy delivery, jabbed away to the bowler
backs away to cut it for a single
rushes down the track, moves outside leg and slices a flighted delivery on leg and middle line over long-off!. He loves to stay beside the line and slice and carve to the off side
works this to sweeper cover
full and outside off, Ojha stays where he is this time but can't connect with the square slash
moves right across, well outside off stump, Albie follows him with a slower one, and Ojha tries to paddle it .. and it goes right between his legs ..
Fab hit. It was the attempted yorker outside off, dropped short of the blockhole , Ojha got his bat down in a hurry, opened its face and sliced the ball sweetly to backward point boundary
short in length and outside off, forced away to Jogi at sweeper cover
slashes this full length delivery to deep-point region
slower one outside off, Ojha can't connect with the square drive
leans forward to push it back to the bowler
on the leg and middle line, swept away for a single
flighted across, spins away from the middle, pushed out wide of cover
moves down the track, looking for the big lofted off drive but is beaten in flight and edges it to short third-man
on the leg and middle line, driven to long-on
gets forward to push inside-out to short cover
leans forward to off drive to long-off
wrists this off break through midwicket

Appeal for a run out breaks away from the off stump, slightly short, cut to left of sweeper cover. Thushara's throw comes in to Dhoni who breaks the stumps with Voges' bat just about making it inside .
gets forward to defend the topspinner from round the stumps
sweeps it to long-leg for a single
leans forward to turn the flighted off break from off stump to backward square-leg
lovely delivery, again turns away from the middle stump and goes past the outside edge
leans forward to on drive it for a single

Jagati takes out Brother Yo. It turned from the middle and leg stump line, Yusuf was looking to work it to the on side and was surprised by the turn. and it perhaps stopped a touch on Yusuf.  It took the leading edge and lobbed to short cover.
width outside off and Yusuf crashes it to the point boundary
almost caught by Murali Yusuf mistimed the pull shot towards long-on .. Murali came in and lunged out but it fell just short
And plays a deft late-cut this time. He is showing us his whole range here today. Fine innings, so far.
gets his own back with a brutal sweep shot. He gave that a good thump
Almost done in bye the doosra... it broke away from the middle and leg line, Ojha had no clue, stabbed inside the line and was beaten
again another wristy dab to left of short fine-leg
outside off stump line , pushed away to backward point
leans forward to work it to left of short fine-leg fielder
holed out to long-on. Fazal rushed down the track but couldn't reach the pitch of the ball and heaved it to Vijay.
gets forward to ping long-off and that's his third IPL Fifty!
turns in to middle and off, tapped to backward point
turns to the off and middle, worked to midwicket
leans forward to push it back to the bowler
backs away to slap it to long-off
pushed to left of short cover for a single
works this one to the on side, along the ground , for a single
Bye bye! This has sailed over long-on. Ojha didn't step out, stayed still before he stretched forward to swing a delivery from outside off to the on side.
skips down the track and lifts it towards long-off.. one bounce to the fielder
just outside off, dabbed towards short third-man
leans forward to drive inside out to cover
moving away from the off stump, Fazal can't connect with the late cut and Dhoni gathers
slower one, outside off, run down to third man
Blast! It was a back of length delivery around off and middle stump line, Ojha stayed on the leg stump, adjacent to the line and punched it on the up to extra-cover boundary. Top shot.
And almost again. This time to the right of third man where Albie makes a fine diving stop
full in length and outside off stump, Ojha slashes it to third man boundary. Carved away.
length delivery from middle and off has been glanced away to fine-leg .. he leaned across to work it right across the line
connects better this time and gets the ball down to long-on
leans forward to mistime the big on drive to the right of Raina who makes a diving stop
skips down the track and drives to long-off
fetches it from outside off and swings it to long-on
from round the stumps to the lefty, on the leg stump line, Fazal chops it towards backward point
gets forward to drive to left of Thushara at long-off
on the middle and leg line, Fazal works it from there towards third man. He is on the leg stump line and stays completely beside the line of the ball.
short in length and outside off, dabbed down to third man
backs away to steer a length delivery from almost middle stump to third man
short in length and outside off, run down to third man
pushes it outside off stump and Fazal slaps it to sweeper cover
goes down the track and has a slog ... edges it to fine-leg boundary. Jogi stands and stares down the pitch.
goes for the sweep again and bottom edges it to left of short fine-leg fielder
goes for the sweep but Murali pushes it away from the off stump line .. Dhoni gathers
spins in from outside leg, moves past the poke to strike the pad
goes back to push the flattish off break on off and middle to point
from round the stumps to the righty Ojha, who blasts it high over wide midwicket boundary! He leaned forward and swung the off break on leg and middle line, with the turn, up and over
from over the wicket, turns in from outside leg, dabbed wide of midwicket
stays back and across to run down the short-of-length delivery to third man
around the off stump line, pushed out to backward point
connects with the pull this time, a single to deep midwicket
slightly short in length on the middle, Ojha is cramped as he goes for the pull and mistimes it towards mid-on but it falls well short of the fielder
on the middle stump line, pushed out to the off side
in the zone outside off, Ojha is beaten, trying to steer to third man
Done in by the slower one. Lumb was completely fooled, tried to check his firm drive but the ball lobbed towards mid-off where Thushara lunged forward to pick up a good catch
Delicious hit over square-leg boundary. It was full pitched and just outside leg stump line and Lumb plays a fab pick-up shot, a whip-flick over the boundary
he cleared the front foot and heaved the length delivery to left of mid-on .. Whack!
moves down the track, it's a slower ball, and he drags it towards deep midwicket region
bounces around off from short of length, guided to third man
back of length outside off stump, and Ojha cracks it away ala Sehwag .. flashed away to backward point boundary. Fab bat speed.
from over the wicket, Murali lands it outside leg and Lumb goes down on his knee to swing it to backward square-leg boundary. Too much width on that one.
goes for the sweep, misses and is struck on the pad
on the middle stump line, turning in, looking for the lbw, jabbed behind square-leg
lands around leg and turns down for a wide
on the middle and leg, from round the stumps, tapped to short midwicket
turns in from outside leg, Lumb stays back to work it towards deep midwicket
leans forward to drive to the off side
Edged  between Hayden and Dhoni. It was a back of a length delivery bouncing across Ojha who goes for the slash over point but edges it high to the left of Hayden, at wide slip.
back of length around middle and off, pushed out to point
full in length around leg stump, Lumb shuffles across and tries to swing it away to the on side, misses and it rolls off the pad
charges out and lifts the short-of-length delivery over cover point. Neatly done. He didn't panic once the bowler shortened the length but adjusted very nicely to carve it up and over
bangeed in short and it goes just down the leg side
slower one, short in length, Lumb is to early into his pull shot and the ball rolls away to the on side
full in length, jabbed away to the off side
Thrash. He moved down the track, also got slightly outside leg and fisted the full delivery through covers
short in length, on the middle and off line, pushed back to the off side
shuffles across to flick to deep backward square-leg
Wallop! Thunderous. He leans forward to swing a full-length delivery over long-on
goes back and across to punch it to cover
short in length and on the leg and middle line, shoveled over square-leg
overpitched outside off, driven to long-off
really full delivery outside off, edges the attempted paddle scoop to short fine-leg
again pushed well outside off, full toss, slapped to deep cover
They can't get bat to ball. Full and pushed outside off stump, squeezes past the attempted hit and the keeper collects
around 125 kmph full, almost loopy delivery well outside off, Karthik edges the drive and Ojha dives to his left to make a fine stop
slips in a slower one, full and outside off, the batsman shuffles across and tries to swing it to the on side but is beaten by the lack of pace
fast and straight, 151.8 kmph outside off, stabbed away for a single
Albie's late charge ends. Tait the man with the breakthrough. He hurled across a bouncer and Albie could only pull it to Fazal at deep midwicket. The Rajasthan dug-out erupts! And why not!
low dipping full toss, pushed out to left of mid-off .. Trivedi deflects it away .. extra run
kicks up from short of length, jabbed to the off side
moves outside leg , Tait fires it full and well outside off, sliced to backward point
banged in short, Badri goes for the pull but mistimes it completely ... and is caught at midwicket ...

OMG! This one lands on the roof! The white ball is bouncing on the roof of the Motera stadium. Warne tried to take pace off the ball but slipped across a full toss. Albie stepped out, waited before lashing it out over deep midwicket. Bye bye! What an over. What a strike by Albie
That's huge. That's brutal and that'ss six over midwicket. He cleared the front foot and crashed the leg break on the middle stump line over the on side
Muscled away! Albie takes a step forward, clears the front foot and heaves it over long-on
stays back, opens his stance and mistimes his pull towards long-on .. he made contact with the bottom of the bat

goes for the slog sweep but the ball dips and spins right past his attempted hit. Ojha takes off the bails in a flash and appeals. Third umpire verdict is not out as Badri had placed his back foot inside the crease
turns in from short of length , from outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
142 kmph, short lifting delivery on middle stump line, BAdri, as is his wont, tries to upper cut it but doesn't connect
short delivery around off stump, around 140 kmph, steered to third man
full delivery but on middle and leg line and Albie whips it to wide midwicket boundary
bangs in a slower bouncer, Albie sways away from the line
full and straight, Albie pushes it back to the bowler.
full in length outside off, punched to deep point
skips down the track, tries to whip it to the onside, misses but collects a leg bye
full and outside off stump, dabbed to backward point

Dhoni is run out and he is furious with Badri .. he had forced it to left of deep midwicket where Voges stops. Dhoni turned back for the second run, both batsmen collide mid-pitch and Dhoni loses his bat .. he runs on but obviously can't reach anywhere close. It would have been tight even if he had the bat in his hand. No chance without it. Dhoni is handed the bat by Warne and he storms off in anger
skids from short of length. dhoni goes for a big pull, misses and is struck on the pad. Going down leg, though
moves outside leg stump, Yusuf follows him, chopped to backward point
goes for the big swing to the on side , rolls away to the off, he sets off for a single before turning back .. Ojha flicks the throw wide of the stumps
fires it down the leg side .. Wide

almost an yorker outside off stump and Badri plays a top-quality shot -- he crouched, opened the bat-face and steered it between backward point and short third man. Quite similar to a shot Manoj Tiwary played yesterday to a attempted yorker from Bopara
slower one, short delivery but Dhoni clubs it straight to long-on . . hmmm
slower one but wide outside off, Dhoni lets it go
low full toss, around 125 kmph slower outside off, Dhoni takes the bottom-hand off the bat to adjust to the lack of pace as he goes for the slog and edges it to fine-leg
moves outside off to swat a low full toss from outside off to deep backward square-leg
full pitched around off and hit straight to long-on.
length delivery well outside off and Dhoni reaches out to whack it to cover boundary
quicker , slips down the leg side , rolls off the pad
skips down the track but is beaten in flight and takes the bottom-hand off the bat and goes through with the swing .. edged past square-leg
moves down the track to drive to long-off
backs away to fist it to long-off.
slower, fuller, tapped to cover point for a single
flat and quickish, short in length too and that length allows Badri to punch it through the line to extra cover boundary
Blast! He walked down the track and swung the length delivery to midwicket boundary.
walks down the track and drives to long-on
short in length outside off, around 122 kmph, forced away to sweeper cover
pushes this to Warne at short extra cover. The required rate is creeping up.
walks down the track and nudges the full one to left of Ojha
moves outside off and paddles the length delivery from outside off to fine-leg
leans forward to flick a legbreak from around off stump to midwicket for a single.
goes for the flipper but it comes badly out of his hand .. short and well outside off, flat batted hard to right of long-off
leans forward to wrist the slider to long-on
goes for the reverse sweep this time but drags it to slip where Yusuf  stops!
flighted leg break around off stump, Badri plays a neat square drive, with the turn, to deep point
slip in place and Badri taps the leg break to backward point
yet another slower one, around 105 kmph, full and on the off and middle, eased past the non-striker
gets forward to push it to mid-off
another slower one, from a length just outside off, run down to the left of third man and Badri pushes Dhoni for the second run
slower one around off stump line, tapped to point ..
gets forward to punch it down to long-on
short in length and outside off, run down to third man
Goes for the skidding flipper this time, skids on from short of length but BAdri does well to take out the front leg out of the way and wrist it through wide midwicket
big ripper this time! It spun past the lunging Badri

The off stump has been pegged back. Warne has struck. He slowed up the pace, tossed it on a length outside off stump, Raina went for the slog sweep but was too early through with his shot, beaten by the lack of pace on that one. The ball turned in ever so gently to hit the off stump. Timber!
turns from the off stump, slower through the air, forced to long-off
pushes it well outside off - that's been the line he has bowled to Raina mostly, cut away past point
Dhoni leans forward to wrist it through midwicket
short in length and outside off, around 122 kmph,. Dhoni goes back and across to punch it to deep-point region
slower bouncer, Dhoni thinks about playing the cut shot but in the end watches the ball bounce to the keeper

Vijay is run out It was flicked to left of square-leg ... and he sets off for a non-existent single as Yusuf is stationed there! Yusuf took couple of steps to his left, picked the ball and its around this time, Vijay started to turn back. Too late. Direct hit. Gone!
slower one outside off, dabbed to backward point
around 128 kmph length delivery on the off stump line, driven uppishly but it dies ahead of Trivedi and goes between his legs!
around 127 kmph short-of-length delivery outside off, punched to short extra cover
leans forward to on drive to long-on
works this past point for a single
Dropped by Ojha. It landed well outside off and sort of straightened. Raina tries to steer it through vacant slip region and it ran off the face of the bat and Ojha can't hold on
stretches forward to play the sweep shot
pushes it well outside off, Raina reaches out to cut it past point
on the leg and middle line, nudged past square-leg
leans forward to ping long-on
moves well outside leg and cuts the short and quick delivery to point boudnary
works this one away for a single
pushes it down the leg side
goes right back to punch it to long-on
stays back to punch it to sweeper cover
leans forward to ping long-on
short in length, kicks up towards middle and leg, tucked away behind square-leg
in the channel outside off stump, Vijay allows it to pass him
fullish, on the middle, eased to wide midwicket

dropped by Lumb at midwicket  Around 145 kmph, another short-of-length delivery, Raina mistimes the pull and Lumb makes a mess.. he didn't seem to see the ball at all, bent down when it was actually coming at a comfortable height ...around his head ... and he ended up sort of palming it over..
144 kmph short-of-length delivery on middle and leg, Raina jumped back to glance it to fine-leg boundary
Under pressure, Narwal slips in a full toss outside off, Vijay drags it wide of mid-on. Thank you very much. Visit again please.
Length delivery moving in to the middle stump line, Vijay cleared the front foot and swung it over wide long-on. Nonchalantly hit.
Dropped by Warne at mid-on Vijay had lifted the length delivery to left of mid-on. didn't time it at all, Warne jogged towards his left and lunged out with his left hand but couldn't hold on
Another slower one, again Vijay reads it well, waits before swatting the short-of-length delivery to fine-leg boundary
leans forward to punch the length delivery to the off side
Vijay picks the slower one very early, shuffles into position, waits before whip lashing it from outside off over deep midwicket. Fabulicious.
moves outside leg and cuts past point ..
slip in place ... the ball comes in with the angle, from round the stumps to strike the pad

Yusuf takes out the big wicket .. It was flighted across and it dipped as a low full toss. Hayden was backing away outside leg and went for the big off drive but connected with the bottom of the bat .. the ball scoops across well to the right of Yusuf who very nonchalantly stretches his right hand out to pluck a low catch!
plays a deft paddle -sweep and it races away to the boundary

backs away from the leg stump and has a slog across the line, misses and the ball goes between him and the leg stump. Ojha breaks the stumps and shouts out an appeal for stumping .. Hayden had pressed his back foot back in time
moves outside leg stump and times the length delivery through covers for couple of runs
slips to the middle and leg line and Vijay is good there, plays an elegant flick past square-leg
banged in short outside off, 151.4 kmph, left alone
full in length around off stump, around 152 kmph. Vijay prefers to stay back to deal with this pacy delivery and pushes it to extra cover
kicks up from short of length on the middle, Hayden opens the bat-face to shovel it clear of backward point, down to third man
around 148 kmph, low dipping full toss, tapped to mid-off
banged in short of length, around 144 kmph, on the leg and middle line, tucked to the on side
mistimes another intended big hit towards mid-on
length delviery homing in on the off stump line, pushed towards mid-off for a quick single ..
leans forward to drive to cover
back of length, pushed out to left of cover for a single
stays to thrash this to right of cover where there is a diving half-stop made .. overthrows though and HAyden gets back
Crashed over long-on. Hayden walks down the track, couple of steps, and clears the front foot and swings through the line.
goes for the pull and Jhunjhunwala makes a diving stop near square-leg
moves outside leg and drag-pulls to deep midwicket
pulls from outside off to deep backward square-leg region
moves outside leg and mistimes the forcing shot to left of mid-on
goes right back to work it to short midwicket
on the off stump line, turns in slightly, pushed towards mid-on for a quick single
